newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Northwest spot prods prices notionally steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Northwest spot prods prices notionally steady.

text.p: U.S. Northwest product prices were notionally steady Friday, after earlier week softness that occured when a pipeline resumed service in the region.
Stable California prices also kept the Pacific Northwest market quiet.
Olympic Pipe Line, which carried about 325,000 barrels-per-day of refined products resumed service early Thursday, the company said earlier.
Regular unleaded gasoline was assessed unchanged at 69.00 to 70.00 cent a gallon.
Premium was seen 7.50 cents a gallon higher.
Jet fuel and low sulphur diesel were notionally stable at 79/80 cents a gallon.
